extracted.intended_audience: new and prospective Wattpad creators / writers and general Wattpad users
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for new Wattpad users and creators on how to use the app/website tabs, manage accounts and libraries, find and save stories, write and publish, and access writer resources and notifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Valid verified email required
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note that every account requires a valid and verified email address to access all elements of the app and website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accounts must use a verified email to access the full site and app functionality. Ensure your email is valid and follow verification steps before attempting to use all platform features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Home Feed / Recommended stories
rubrics_metrics.description: Your Home (also known as the Home Feed) is where recommended stories appear.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommendations are made on many different algorithms, but are primarily impacted by the stories you have been reading. You can adjust your content preferences by clicking on the toggles icon to turn off certain types of stories and tags.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search by title, username, topics and tags
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the search bar to search story titles and usernames. You can also browse through topics or tags using the '#' symbol.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search lets you find specific stories or creators; use '#' to browse tags and topics. When you find a story of interest, you can add it to your Library, Archive, or one of your Reading Lists to save it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Save and organize discovered stories (Library/Archive/Reading Lists)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you see a story you’re interested in, you can add it to your Library, Archive, or one of your Reading Lists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Library, Archive, and Reading Lists to organize and keep track of stories you want to follow or read later. These tools help manage discovered content and keep updates available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Library is private and used to track favorites
rubrics_metrics.description: Your Library is a way to stay updated on your favorite stories and keep track of all the ones you’re interested in. It’s private to your account and cannot be seen by anyone else.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Library functions as a personal tracking tool for stories; privacy means others cannot view your Library contents. See 'managing your Library' resources for organization tips.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write tab — create, continue, and access writer resources
rubrics_metrics.description: As a creator, you’ll spend lots of time in the Write tab. Here, you can create a new story or continue writing one you’ve already started.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Write tab also links to helpful writer resources and more information about writing on the platform, including how to publish your first story. Use this tab to draft, edit, and manage your own stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updates tab — notifications, messages, and inbox privacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Access your notifications and messages in the Updates tab. Here, you’ll receive notifications about comments, announcements, private messages, story updates, mentions, and new followers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The messages inbox holds private conversations only visible to you and another user. Use Updates to monitor engagement and community interaction on your stories and profile.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult Wattpad writer resources and Story School topics
rubrics_metrics.description: Wattpad provides a suite of writer resources including: Getting connected; Personalizing your profile; How to publish your first story; Categorizing your story on Wattpad; Advice from Creators; Webnovel essentials; Story and scene structure; Character (GMCS); Wattpad tropes and genres; Planning a story; Setting and worldbuilding; Sentence-level writing; Serialized storytelling; Writing diversity: tips for inclusive stories; Opportunities and marketing tips; Community guidelines and safety.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these topic pages as a one-stop shop for craft, publishing, categorization, inclusivity, marketing, and community-safety guidance. Each topic links to more detailed guidance (e.g., publishing steps, categorization, and safety rules).
